method.promotion_rule: Promote only numeric sizing whose source, unit, audience/category scope, and body-vs-garment measurement basis can be verified.
method.audience_rule: Test adult women, adult men, unisex, infant, toddler, kids and youth independently when applicable.
method.scope_rule: Do not generalize a product-family or fit-specific chart to unrelated categories.
